items.exampleEn: There are many things in my bag.
items.exampleZh: 我的包包裡有很多東西。

items.exampleEn: We had a great time at the party.
items.exampleZh: 我們在派對上玩得很開心。

items.exampleEn: They live in a big house.

items.sentenceEn: My new bag is very big.

items.audioEn: My old phone is good, but I want a new one.
items.audioZh: 我的舊手機還不錯，但我想要一支新的。

items.sentenceEn: This old house has a great garden.
items.sentenceZh: 這棟老房子有一個很棒的花園。

items.sentenceEn: These shoes are good for walking.

items.stemEn: My grandfather is eighty. He is very ____.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺八十歲了，他年紀很大。

items.passageEn: Tom has a new job in a big city. He lives in an old building, but his room is great. It is on the tenth floor, high above the street. From his window, he can see many things. He is happy to have his own room.
items.passageZh: Tom 在一個大城市找到新工作。他住在一棟舊大樓裡，但他的房間很棒。房間在十樓，離街面很高。從窗戶他可以看到很多東西。他很高興有自己的房間。

questions.questionZh: Tom 住在什麼樣的建築裡？

items.promptZh: 我想要一台新的腳踏車。
rubricZh: 形容詞 new 放在名詞前面（例如 a new bike）
「腳踏車」可用 bike 或 bicycle

items.instructionZh: 用 own 造一個句子，說說某樣你自己擁有、不跟別人共用的東西。
referenceEn: I have my own desk at work.
rubricZh: own 放在所有格後面、接名詞（例如 my own room）；寫 … is my own 也正確
用動詞 own 表示「擁有」（例如 I own a bike）也正確
